title: Cell-Hub: a graphical interface for end-to-end single-cell RNA sequencing analysis
description: Cell-Hub, an open-source R/Shiny application for single-cell and single-nucleus RNA sequencing analysis (Seurat v5, CellChat 2, Monocle 3, Visium and Visium HD), distributed as the Docker image gaspardmacaux/cell-hub. The image digest of each version is given in the release notes and the README.
